before.assessment_basis: Runtime admission policy is materially relevant to a tool operation activating after the user expressly withheld image-generation permission. The July 2026 report postdates SDOS v1.10. The capture supports unwanted invocation but does not disclose explicit agent admission, scope criteria or the configuration-controlled default-deny gate. It cannot resolve this specific admission-control proposition; ordinary conversational availability is not evidence that the required agent admission held. Voluntary adoption is not a prerequisite.
before.identification_basis: The evidenced excluded-tool operation independently raises this runtime-admission proposition. It does not depend on a capability-as-permission classification.

after.assessment_basis: The capture shows image-generation activity after the user expressly withheld permission. It does not show whether the agent had undergone explicit admission before that tool operation or how existing sessions were treated. Conversation access alone cannot establish the required admission step.
after.identification_basis: The evidenced excluded-tool operation independently raises this runtime-admission proposition. It does not depend on a capability-as-permission classification.
